orig_text:
The query MUST NOT be for record type ANY (255), class ANY (255), or
class NONE (0).
correct_text:
The query MUST NOT be for record type ANY (255), class ANY (255), or
class NONE (254).
notes:
DNS class NONE was assigned value 254, see DNS CLASSes IANA registry line:
254 	0x00FE 	QCLASS NONE 	[RFC 2136]

This value comes from RFC 2136 section 1.3 - New Assigned Numbers.
